---
title: biblint
---

`biblint` is a BibTeX linter and formatter.
Commit `biblint.toml` so collaborators and CI use the same policy.

## Commands

```console
biblint check .
biblint check . --format
biblint check references.bib --format --fix
biblint check references.bib --format --fix --unsafe-fixes
biblint check . --output json
biblint format references.bib
biblint format . --check
biblint format references.bib --diff
biblint rule
biblint rule duplicate_key
```

`check` reports syntax and lint diagnostics by default.
`check --format` additionally reports whether files would be reformatted.
`format` writes the configured representation, `--check` reports whether a file would change, and `--diff` prints the change without writing it.

Both commands accept files, directories, and standard input (`-`).
Directories contribute `.bib` files recursively.
See [Configuration](configuration.qmd) for discovery and policy settings.

## Workflow

Use `check` to review a project and `format` to apply its configured format:

```console
biblint check .
biblint check . --format --fix
biblint format references.bib --diff
```

`check --format --fix` applies safe formatting changes.
Key generation, merging, field removal, brace removal, and author truncation also require `--unsafe-fixes`.

## Defaults

Without a configuration file, `format` normalizes layout, entry types, and field names while preserving value spelling.
Other transforms and optional checks are enabled in `biblint.toml`.
